                                                      PROJECT NO. 58481
              RULEMAKING TO IMPLEMENT                              §      PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION
              LARGE LOAD INTERCONNECTION §                         §
              STANDARDS UNDER PURA §37.0561                        §               OF TEXAS



                                   COMMENTS OF EXXON MOBIL CORPORATION

                                                         I.   COMMENTS

                     Exxon Mobil Corporation (ExxonMobil) appreciates the opportunity to submit these
            comments to address Draft NEW 16 TAC §25.194, Project Number 58481 (Proposed Rule).
            Specifically, ExxonMobil addresses section (l) of the Proposed Rule, which states:

                     (l)     ERCOT operational standards.

                             (1)      ERCOT may establish operational standards for large load customers to
                                      ensure system reliability.

                             (2)      A large load customer must comply with operational standards, developed
                                      through ERCOT protocols, as a condition for interconnection and continued
                                      operation of the customer's load.

            ExxonMobil supports TIEC’s and TXOGA’s comments on this matter and is deeply concerned
            about the risks of subjecting ExxonMobil’s and its affiliates’ diverse industrial facility loads to
            ERCOT’s control and operational standards. Industrial facilities are not “one-size fits all” –
            different industries and different sites have very dissimilar operating characteristics, which makes
            imposing singular operational standards particularly challenging. Our facilities operate under
            highly complex conditions, and forcing them to adhere to operational standards for which they are
            not designed could result in disruption to our equipment and essential operations, potentially
            resulting in severe health, safety, and economic consequences.

            ExxonMobil appreciates the opportunity to comment on the Proposed Rule and looks forward to
            further participation.
